datasets.title: San Marino - Age and Gender Structures (2015-2030)
datasets.description: Estimates of total number of people per grid square broken down by gender and age groupings (including 0-1 and by 5-year up to 90+) for San Marino, R2025A version v1. The dataset is available to download in Geotiff format at a resolution of 3 arc (approximately 100m at the equator). The projection is Geographic Coordinate System, WGS84. The units are estimated number of male, female or both in each age group per grid square. More information can be found in the Release Statement Please note that these data represent 2025 Alpha release versions, constructed in September 2025 File Descriptions: {iso} {gender} {age group} {year} {type} {resolution}.tif iso Three-letter country code gender m = male, f= female, t = both genders age group 00 = age group 0 to 12 months 01 = age group 1 to 4 years 05 = age group 5 to 9 years 90 = age 90 years and over year Year that the population represents type CN = Constrained resolution Resolution of the data e.q. 100m = 3 arc (approximately 100m at the equator). [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/worldpop-age-and-gender-structures-2015-2030-smr]
datasets.details: Data for earlier dates is available directly from WorldPop Bondarenko M., Priyatikanto R., Tejedor-Garavito N., Zhang W., McKeen T., Cunningham A., Woods T., Hilton J., Cihan D., Nosatiuk B., Brinkhoff T., Tatem A., Sorichetta A.. 2025. Estimates of 2015-2030 total number of people per grid square broken down by gender and age groupings at a resolution of 3 arc (approximately 100m at the equator) R2025A version v1. Global Demographic Data Project - Funded by The Bill and Melinda Gates Foundation (INV-045237). WorldPop - School of Geography and Environmental Science, University of Southampton. DOI:10.5258/SOTON/WP00841

lineage.description: Population estimates were generated by WorldPop using a Random Forest-based dasymetric disaggregation model that redistributes national census and administrative population counts into gridded surfaces at approximately 100m resolution, incorporating geospatial covariates such as land cover, building footprints, and road networks. Age and gender structures are applied to the total population grid using demographic data from national statistics and UN population projections for the period 2015–2030. The resulting GeoTIFF rasters provide annual, sex- and age-disaggregated population counts per grid cell for use in exposure assessment and disaster risk analysis.

sources.name: WorldPop Global 2015-2030 R2025A v1
sources.description: WorldPop's modelled gridded population dataset providing age- and gender-disaggregated population counts per grid square at 100m and 1km resolution, derived from census data and ancillary geospatial covariates using a Random Forest-based dasymetric mapping approach.
